g.text: In a 2023 test, at least one of seven detectors flagged 89 of 91 essays
written by non-native English speakers for the TOEFL
Each square = one human-written essay. Source: Liang et al. (2023), Patterns: seven detectors as of early 2023; 91 TOEFL essays from one Chinese
forum. Counts derived from the paper's 97.8% (at least one detector) and 19.8% (all seven). Average false-positive rate: 61.3%.
